availability_reason.privacy: content-free; no message, details, path, id, hash, or arbitrary string fields

admission.composition_failure: closed availability reason only; no provider resend, chat corruption, fabricated zero, or fabricated exact usage
admission.malformed_extension: extension_invalid; base ProviderCallReceipt and RunBundle remain valid
admission.missing_extension: extension_missing; base ProviderCallReceipt and RunBundle remain valid
admission.runtime_features: composition_availability_only; missing slugs return capability_unavailable and never block ordinary V4/provider send, tools, interactions, or base RunBundle

electron_persistence.continuity: existing ProviderCallReceipt extension -> RunBundle -> bundle_json -> assistant meta.bundle -> TraceChain

fresh_hint.admission: fresh-only sidecar authoritative recomputation must exactly match one-item skills/expanded_invocation/messages positive-safe-integer hint before atomic private mint
fresh_hint.failure: invalid=fresh_hint_invalid; authoritative mismatch=fresh_hint_mismatch; never persisted; ordinary V4 send continues

privacy.digests: call-local envelope/route integrity evidence only; never displayed or indexed across users
privacy.persisted_content: only frozen category/subtype/surface IDs, bounded counts/tokens/enums, and call-local integrity digests; raw or arbitrary content-bearing fields fail closed

quality.overestimate: preserve category/subtype estimates; estimated or partial; residual null; percentage null; never normalize to 100%
quality.reconciled: only reconciled_estimate has non-null residual and attributed+residual equality to receipt provider input total
quality.unreconciled: estimated or partial requires residual null and percentage null; provider-total unavailable or attributed overestimate also forces percentage null

resume_hint.failure: malformed=resume_hint_invalid; unequal=resume_hint_mismatch; present-with-no-baseline=resume_hint_no_baseline; no mint/overwrite; ordinary V4 resume continues
resume_hint.rehydration: byte-identical through stable durable option allowlist, graph-step, and resume; arbitrary component_state is not authority
resume_hint.rule: absence uses durable value; exact canonical declaration equality is no-write/no-version-advance

invariants: wheel_sha256 is the one immutable wheel used by test matrix and actual import
producer_contract_digest and consumer_contract_digest equal the approved boundary_revision_set pair
matrix_results contains every required cell exactly once in canonical id order
active rollout requires every matrix status PASS; FAIL, NOT_RUN, PENDING, missing, duplicate, unknown, or digest mismatch blocks rollout

selector_invariants.model_call: one exact physical provider_call_id and its exact authoritative route extension
selector_invariants.percentage: non-null only for reconciled_estimate with reported provider total and valid equality
selector_invariants.run_tree: deterministic set union of existing receipt set and all_call_ids; root/graph/subagent; each physical primary/retry/fallback receipt counted once
selector_invariants.unmatched_route: composition unavailable or partial; never guess another route
selector_invariants.unknown_or_corrupt: composition unavailable; never synthesize from legacy totals
